Feature engineering: a stateful FeatureEngineer builds numeric base features (age/income/education/time/expiration ordinal encodings, frequency encodings, distance estimates, coupon-type indicators, interaction terms) and leakage-safe smoothed target encodings for several categorical and combo sources, using out-of-fold encodings for training (fit_transform) and full-data encodings for inference (transform), with standardization. Model: a TabM batch-ensemble MLP (input projection, rank-1 perturbation blocks shared across K heads, per-head output layers) trained with CrossEntropy label smoothing via AdamW and cosine LR scheduling, grad clipping, and early stopping on validation accuracy. Validation: 5-fold StratifiedKFold with OOF accuracy, per-fold feature engineers and models saved, then averaged predictions across folds at inference; final output written as row_id,prediction CSV with original label restoration."}
